name: @alicelabs/cline-trust-plugin
description: Trust verification plugin for Cline — the UTA Interceptor. v1.1.0: revocation gate (fail-closed OCSP-style checks against the signed MarketNow Revocation Registry) + TFP-1.0 tool-surface pinning and drift detection (OWASP 'verify tool descriptions haven't changed'). Still wraps MCP servers with pre-exec filter, credential protection, and Merkle tree audit log.
author: AliceLabs LLC

cline.description: Wraps all MCP servers with trust verification — blocks .env reads, rm -rf, shell spawns. v1.1.0: revocation gate + tool-surface fingerprint pinning. Logs to Merkle tree.

tools.name: verify_trust
tools.description: Verify the trust score of any MCP server or credential

tools.name: check_interceptor
tools.description: Check if a tool call would be blocked by the interceptor (includes the v1.1.0 revocation gate when configured)

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Get the Merkle tree audit log of all intercepted calls

tools.name: scan_mcp_server
tools.description: Scan an MCP server for security threats (9,248 servers scanned)

tools.name: check_revocation
tools.description: OCSP-style revocation status of an ATC (card_id) or CA key (kid) against the signed MarketNow Revocation Registry — fail-closed

tools.name: pin_tool_surface
tools.description: Pin an MCP server's tool surface (TFP-1.0 fingerprint manifest) — first-contact pinning against tool poisoning

tools.name: verify_tool_surface
tools.description: Verify a server's current tools/list against the pinned manifest — drift report for rug-pull detection
